'''Kirbi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. On [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Kirbi and a team of Jedi attempted to find a way to reverse the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], but were killed by [[nekghoul]]s.
